package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const (
	workspaceStudentID  = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	workspacePathID     = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	workspaceCourseID   = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	workspaceLessonID   = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	workspacePracticeID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
)

func TestBuildStudentLearningWorkspaceProjectsOnlySelectedActivePath(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	result, err := BuildStudentLearningWorkspace(StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{
		StudentID: workspaceStudentID,
		Context: StudentLearningContext{
			Schema: LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: workspaceStudentID,
			SelectedLearningPathID: workspacePathID, Version: 7, UpdatedAt: &now,
		},
		SelectedPath: &StudentLearningPath{
			ID: workspacePathID, StudentID: workspaceStudentID, CourseID: workspaceCourseID,
			GoalCode: "learn_programming", CurriculumRevision: "sha256:current-only",
			PolicyVersion: LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v1",
			ReasonCode: "initial_route", ReasonSummary: "Initial route", Status: LearningPathStatusActive,
			Version: 3, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
			Items: []LearningPathItem{
				{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: workspaceLessonID, Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_gap", Targets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.basics"}}},
				{ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: workspacePracticeID, Position: 1, Status: LearningPathItemInProgress, ReasonCode: "active_practice"},
			},
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build workspace: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Schema != StudentLearningWorkspaceSchema || result.ContextVersion != 7 || result.SelectedPath == nil ||
		result.SelectedPath.LearningPathID != workspacePathID || result.SelectedPath.CourseID != workspaceCourseID ||
		len(result.SelectedPath.Items) != 2 || result.SelectedPath.Items[1].Status != LearningPathItemInProgress {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected workspace: %#v", result)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"student_id", "curriculum_revision", "targets", "reason_code", "planner_policy", "request_id"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(encoded), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("workspace leaked %q: %s", forbidden, encoded)
		}
	}
}

func TestBuildStudentLearningWorkspaceRejectsForeignOrInactiveSelectedPath(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	base := StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{
		StudentID:    workspaceStudentID,
		Context:      StudentLearningContext{Schema: LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: workspaceStudentID, SelectedLearningPathID: workspacePathID, Version: 1, UpdatedAt: &now},
		SelectedPath: &StudentLearningPath{ID: workspacePathID, StudentID: workspaceStudentID, CourseID: workspaceCourseID, GoalCode: "learn_programming", CurriculumRevision: "r1", PolicyVersion: LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial", ReasonSummary: "Initial", Status: LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: workspaceLessonID, Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_gap"}}},
	}
	foreign := base
	foreign.SelectedPath = &StudentLearningPath{}
	*foreign.SelectedPath = *base.SelectedPath
	foreign.SelectedPath.StudentID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	if _, err := BuildStudentLearningWorkspace(foreign); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("foreign selected path unexpectedly projected")
	}
	inactive := base
	inactive.SelectedPath = &StudentLearningPath{}
	*inactive.SelectedPath = *base.SelectedPath
	inactive.SelectedPath.Status = LearningPathStatusPaused
	if _, err := BuildStudentLearningWorkspace(inactive); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("inactive selected path unexpectedly projected")
	}
}

func TestBuildStudentLearningWorkspaceAllowsNoSelectedPathWithoutInventingOne(t *testing.T) {
	result, err := BuildStudentLearningWorkspace(StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{StudentID: workspaceStudentID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build empty workspace: %v", err)
	}
	if result.ContextVersion != 0 || result.SelectedPath != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected empty workspace: %#v", result)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeStudentLearningWorkspaceRejectsSelectedPathWithoutItems(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := NormalizeStudentLearningWorkspace(StudentLearningWorkspace{
		Schema: StudentLearningWorkspaceSchema, ContextVersion: 1,
		SelectedPath: &StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath{
			LearningPathID: workspacePathID, CourseID: workspaceCourseID,
			Status: LearningPathStatusActive, PathVersion: 1, Items: []StudentLearningWorkspaceItem{},
		},
	})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("selected_path without items unexpectedly normalized")
	}
}
